versions.subject: Converted Sysmon/1 and Security/4688 to generic process creation rules
versions.detection:
selection:
  CommandLine:
    - '*certutil * -decode *'
    - '*certutil * -decodehex *'
    - '*certutil *-urlcache* http*'
    - '*certutil *-urlcache* ftp*'
    - '*certutil *-URL*'
    - '*certutil *-ping*'
    - '*certutil.exe * -decode *'
    - '*certutil.exe * -decodehex *'
    - '*certutil.exe *-urlcache* http*'
    - '*certutil.exe *-urlcache* ftp*'
    - '*certutil.exe *-URL*'
    - '*certutil.exe *-ping*'
condition: selection
versions.spl: CommandLine IN ("*certutil * -decode *", "*certutil * -decodehex *", "*certutil *-urlcache* http*", "*certutil *-urlcache* ftp*", "*certutil *-URL*", "*certutil *-ping*", "*certutil.exe * -decode *", "*certutil.exe * -decodehex *", "*certutil.exe *-urlcache* http*", "*certutil.exe *-urlcache* ftp*", "*certutil.exe *-URL*", "*certutil.exe *-ping*")
